notes.title: Endless Update
notes.content:
Endless Mode is an optional mode that shows up after completing all floors of a dungeon.
How far can you go? 

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless Mode
[*] Double click QoL improvements, makes it easier to combine skills faster.
[*] Golden Goblet enable/disable issue fix.
[*] Enchanted Tome buff (-15 % -> -7.5% skill potency)
[*] Tornado nerf (40 -> 30 base damage)
[/list]

notes.title: QoL & Bugfixing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated Korean, japanese and portugese languages
[*] Fixed the Golden Goblet / Investment  and Royal Guardian Relic / Necromonicon bug
[*] Sigil Stone now correctly removes 15 gold.
[*] Fix Skill tooltip issues
[*] Sandstorm effect kicks in after 60 seconds of battle to prevent infinite battles.
[*] Hotkeys added:
[olist]
[*] Sell skill - E
[*] Refresh - D
[*] Buy XP  - F
[/olist]
[*] Increased coin limit to 999
[*] Fix 16:10 resolution issues (Steam Deck)
[*] Fixed cracking sound on game startup
[*] Scattershot arrow projectile visual fix
[/list]

notes.title: Vault of Power, out now!
notes.content:
Jump in now and battle it out in Dreadspire Keep, Blightspill Passage and Undead Sanctum. Earn gems and aquire new relics. There are 10 difficulty levels to master for each dungeon for the players who want an even harder challenge.

Thank you all for providing me with excellent feeback, Vault of Power would not be the same without it.

I hope you enjoy the game, feel free to leave feedback in the Steam Discussions and I will have a look!

/ Jim

notes.title: Korean Language Update
notes.content:
Thanks to Aramus and his friends (HELLMETT and DAWI), there is now a Korean language option in the demo!

Let me know if you find any issues with the patch, I might have missed something.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Increased range for Ranger skills
[*] Changed arrow sprites
[*] Minor changes to Dwarf ally (Paladin bonus)
[/list]

notes.title: Small demo fixes
notes.content:
Only some smaller changes to the demo.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Updated main menu
[*] Fix incorrect healing at rank 3 for all healing skills
[*] Removed strange unit movement that happened sometimes
[*] Unit Casting time set to 1 s for all units (was 1 s for player and 1.5 s for all other units before).
[*] Some skills & enemies have been rebalanced
[*] Nova storm bugfix, sometimes hit wrong targets
[*] Bugfix for where projectiles/tornados could stay active after round was over.
[*] Bugfix damage count in Results menu
[*] Bugfix Reap targeting (enemy casts)
[/list]

Known bugs:
Skills sometimes get stuck when combining (rare bug)

Let me know if you have any suggestions or find any bugs!

/ Jim

notes.title: Relics Update
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added relics (20 available in the demo)
[*] Most AoE skills now follow their targets
[*] Meteor, Reap, Tornado starts on cooldown
[*] Skill UI rework
[*] Skill & Classes rebalancing
[*] Dreadspire Keep: 30 floors instead of 20
[*] Some new enemies & some changes for existing ones
[*] Hotkey: Enter to start battle
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

Known bugs:
Skills sometimes get stuck when combining (rare bug)

Let me know if you have any suggestions/balance issues or find any bugs!

notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.content:
